description:
Rotary Club of Bombay Bayview Partners with Sun Pharma for Cancer Screening

Taking preventive healthcare to underserved communities.

RCBB, in collaboration with Sun Pharma under its CSR initiative – SUNkalp, has embarked on a series of free cancer screening camps across Mumbai.

The first camp was successfully conducted at Asalfa Municipal Dispensary, where 72 beneficiaries were screened for Oral, Breast and Cervical cancer.

The initiative aims to take essential screening facilities to underserved communities, promoting early detection and timely medical intervention. Beneficiaries requiring further investigation are also supported through diagnostic and referral services.

With a camp investment of ₹2.50 lakh, this marks the beginning of a series of camps planned across Mumbai.

A meaningful step towards preventive healthcare and our commitment to Create Lasting Impact.

#EarlyDetectionSavesLives
